title: Albert Stein's deathbed call to Sheehan

tellings.quote: Albert Stein was this guy's name uh he called me on his deathbed uh he was dying up in in northern Minnesota

plain: A man named Albert Stein called Dan Sheehan from his deathbed in a hospice in northern Minnesota. Sheehan, a guest who says he was involved in many famous American cases, tells it as a call he received himself. He presents it as a last confession from someone who knew something important.
